lines.2: 「They forgot to tell me. Said you should train me as hard as you can.」
lines.3: What kind of parents were they?
lines.16: 「You cannot state your wishes clearly. That concerns me.」
lines.19: 「...No. The world needs people like that too, doesn't it?」
lines.21: 「Blurting out everything you feel on impulse is foolish.」
lines.22: 「Letting yourself get carried away is never a good idea.」
lines.23: 「I can't understand people who do that.」
lines.24: 「But this is a case where speaking plainly would benefit us both. Am I wrong?」
lines.26: 「I understand that you avoid surrendering to emotion and instead restrain yourself. That is admirable. Patience is necessary.」
lines.27: 「But restraint and refusing to say what you wish to say are not always the same thing.」
lines.28: 「You're a coward. You're afraid of what might change after you let yourself get carried away.」
lines.31: 「What the hell is that supposed to mean?」
lines.32: 「You barge in here and start saying whatever you want about me... Calling me a coward and everything.」
lines.33: 「Maybe you're right, but unlike you, tough-as-nails Otome, I'm a sensitive person.」
lines.35: 「You've always been like this. All I remember from when we were kids is you scolding me.」
lines.37: But I had to say at least that much to get it out of my system.
lines.38: 「That is because you were so irresponsible. As your blood relative, I--!」
lines.39: Otome cut herself off and shook her head hard.
lines.41: 「...Forgive me. That was too harsh, especially when I have only just arrived.」
lines.42: 「It is an old habit. Somehow, with you, I always speak too bluntly.」
lines.43: Otome was older than me, and it showed in her maturity.
lines.44: She pulled back before it could become a real argument.
lines.45: That left us with this awkward atmosphere.
lines.46: --See? Nothing good came of getting swept up in emotion. Even a little of it did this.
lines.47: 「But just now, you did tell me how you felt.」
lines.48: 「Thanks to that, I understand what you were thinking, and I was able to reflect on my own conduct.」
lines.50: But looking at it that way did make me feel lighter.
lines.51: 「That said, it appears I am indeed a nag.」
lines.53: 「Give me a clear answer, Leo. If you do not want me here, I will go home. I would rather not be hated.」
lines.54: 「And even if you refuse, I will not hold it against you.」
